title: Meeting a New Classmate
description: Four short recordings about a new classmate: a first meeting, a class introduction, a phone message and lunchtime.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · A first meeting
parts.intro: You will hear a new student, Khoa, meeting Anna on his first day.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Hello! Are you the new student? I'm Anna.

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Yes, I am. My name is Khoa. Nice to meet you.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Nice to meet you, too. Where are you from, Khoa?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: I'm from Da Nang, in Vietnam. But now I live here, near the library.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Oh, that's close to my house! How old are you?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: I'm twelve. My birthday is in June. And you?

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: I'm twelve, too. My birthday is in March. Do you like sport?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Yes, I love basketball. I play every Saturday.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Great! I like swimming. Come on, I'll show you the classroom.

parts.title: Part 2 · A class introduction
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher, Mrs Hart, introducing a new girl to the class.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Good morning, class. Today we have a new classmate. Her name is Maria.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Maria is from Spain. She speaks Spanish and a little English, so please speak slowly.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: She has got a younger brother. He is in Class Two, down the corridor.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Maria likes drawing and music. She plays the guitar. Maybe she can play for us on Friday.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Maria, please sit next to Tom, by the window. Tom, please be kind and help her with the books.

script.speaker: Mrs Hart
script.text: Now, everyone, open your books at page ten.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear Tom leaving a message for his friend Khoa.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Hi, Khoa. It's Tom from school. Mrs Hart gave me your number.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I want to say welcome to our class. I hope you like it here.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: The school football team practises on Wednesday after school. Do you want to come?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: We meet at the gym at four o'clock. You don't need special shoes. Just wear your trainers.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Maybe we can walk to school together tomorrow. I live on Green Street. I'll wait at the bus stop at half past seven.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Call me back if you're free. Bye!

parts.title: Part 4 · At lunchtime
parts.intro: You will hear Khoa and Maria talking at lunch.

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Hi, Maria. Can I sit here?

script.speaker: Maria
script.text: Of course, Khoa. I'm new too, so I don't know many people.

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Me neither. What's your favourite subject?

script.speaker: Maria
script.text: I like art. I don't like maths. It's difficult for me.

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: I like maths! I can help you, if you want.

script.speaker: Maria
script.text: That's very kind. Thank you. What's in your lunch box?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Rice, chicken and an apple. My mum made it. What about you?

script.speaker: Maria
script.text: I have a cheese sandwich and some grapes. Would you like some?

script.speaker: Khoa
script.text: Yes, please. Thank you. We are friends now!
